summary: Frontend UI testing for complete Login Page redesign with lamp-based login reveal. All 16 test cases PASSED.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Complete login page redesign verified. Key features: 1) Default state: lamp OFF, login form hidden, 'PULL TO LOGIN' label visible. 2) Clicking pull cord toggles lamp ON, reveals login form with slide animation, label changes to 'PULL TO DIM'. 3) Clicking cord again hides login form. 4) Space background with stars, nebula, moon. 5) Floating vehicles (rocket, car, train, bike, turbine, plane) with drift animation. 6) 5 mini bearings with spin animation. 7) Main bearing with 10 balls, warm glow when lamp ON. 8) 'CAPEX Procurement Portal' title visible. 9) 'Saurabh Jangir' creator branding visible. 10) Login form has email, password, forgot password, Login button, Google sign-in. 11) Login works with admin credentials, navigates to /admin. 12) Emergent badge hidden everywhere (CSS + JS removal).
